title: Curate executive summary and customer-facing changelog for upcoming runtime and console patch
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Produce a structured, three-tiered changelog deliverable for the upcoming patch: 1) a one-paragraph executive summary for leadership and account execs, 2) a customer-facing changelog (bullet list: notable fixes, behavior changes, migration guidance), and 3) an internal rollout note for SRE, Support, and Sales with troubleshooting tips and rollback indicators. Coordinate cross-team reviews (Engineering, Design, Legal, Sales, Support) and produce final artifacts in the canonical docs repo and Marketing Drive. Ensure redaction of any internal-only details and include an embargo schedule and signoff log.
acceptance_criteria: Executive summary written, <=150 words, approved by PM + Eng lead
Customer-facing changelog drafted and copyedited, linked in docs repo
Internal rollout note includes known regressions, hitlist of monitoring dashboards, and suggested KB updates
Legal redaction completed (redaction checklist itemized in comments)
Signoff recorded in #releases Slack channel and in PR description
Final artifacts published to docs.redwood.ai/changelogs and marketing drive before embargo expires
